items.name: Diamond
items.description: The birthstone for April, the diamond is the hardest of all metals and retains its form for decades and centuries without losing its sparkle.

items.name: Pearl
items.description: The birthstone for June, the pearl is a biogenic mineral produced by pearl shells. Even Japan, with its lack of mineral deposits, was able to offer the world its share of beautiful jewelry thanks to its use of pearl farming.

items.name: Sapphire
items.description: The birthstone for September, the sapphire was considered a symbol of the clergy in medieval Europe, with even the Pope sporting a sapphire ring. It is a blue gem symbolizing loyalty and purity.

items.name: Emerald
items.description: The birthstone for May, the emerald has a long history going back to ancient Babylonia, where it was traded. Queen Cleopatra was a fan of its green glimmer.

items.name: Ruby
items.description: The birthstone for July, the name ruby comes from ruber, the Latin word for red. Its passionate color offers the courage to pursue one's goal and is said to make one's romantic wishes come true.

items.name: Jade
items.description: The birthstone for May, jade is a green jewel with more of a history in Japan and China than in the West. It symbolizes authority and status.

items.name: Opal
items.description: The birthstone for October, the opal is a beautiful gem that glitters in many different colors. It was known as the gem of the gods in ancient Rome, where it was held in very high esteem.

items.name: Amethyst
items.description: The birthstone for February, the amethyst is named after Amethystos, a servant to Diana, the Greek goddess of the moon, whose story ended in tragedy.

items.name: Peridot
items.description: The birthstone for August, the peridot has an olive glimmer that has been believed since ancien times to have the power to heal and ward off evil.

items.name: Turquoise
items.description: The birthstone for December, turquoise has long been considered a sacred stone in many parts of the world. The ancient Egyptians offered it as gifts to the gods Osiris and Isis.

items.name: Garnet
items.description: The birthstone for January, the garnet's amber glow was said to have acted as a guiding light for Noah as he sailed the dark, flooded world in his ark.

items.name: Topaz
items.description: The birthstone for November, the topaz normally comes in yellow, but can also be found in blue, green and pink. It symbolizes friendship and hope.

items.name: Coral
items.description: A birthstone for March, coral is a biogenic mineral produced in the sea. Coral is said to bring luck and beauty to young women in Scotland, and is used in the jewelry handed down among the British royalty.

items.name: Aquamarine
items.description: A birthstone for March, aquamarine has a translucent blue color like the sea. European sailors once considered this gem to contain the powers of the sea and kept them as lucky charms.

items.name: Philosopher's Stone
items.description: A lovely gem that countless alchemists once attempted to find. Perhaps it was formed by the indefatigable dreams of these men, who never gave up in their fruitless pursuit. It can be used with a demon of any race when performing Crystallize Demon, and will increase the success rate.

Effect is canceled if you log out or switch channels.

items.name: Jet War Fan
items.description: Listen and tremble!! This war fan, with its unique folds, can create jet air currents that can hurl jokes faster than the speed of sound! Yeah, it's just a gag item.

items.name: Sword of Sunlight
items.description: [Players at Level 91 or Above Only] A sword blessed by Suryaprabha, bodhisattva of sunlight. It is said that fusing this weapon with its counterpart, the Sword of Moonlight, will allow it to regain its original powers and form.

items.name: Sword of Moonlight
items.description: [Players at Level 91 or Above Only] A sword blessed by Candraprabha, bodhisattva of moonlight. It is said that fusing this weapon with its counterpart, the Sword of Sunlight, will allow it to regain its original powers and form.

items.name: Sorrowful Thunder
items.description: [Players at Level 86 or Above Only] A Blade of the Thunder God with its full potential unleashed. The lightning that shoots out of its blade can even decimate the lost souls of Hell.

items.name: Sorrowful Storm
items.description: [Players at Level 86 or Above Only] A Blade of the Wind God with its full potential unleashed. The hurricanes that spin out from its blade can even blow away the most ancient of grudges.

items.name: Star Lemon
items.description: A strange lemon that makes the owner want to constantly strike a pose.

items.name: Demon Hagoita (Nandi)
items.description: Happy New Year!

items.name: Demon Hagoita (Gyuki)
items.description: Happy New Year!

items.name: Tyrfing
items.description: [Players at Level 70 or Above Only] A magical sword that is said to bring certain victory to its wielder. It grants 3 wishes, but those who yearn for more are guide straight to the Underworld.

items.name: Curved Edge
items.description: The smooth curve of this weapon's blade allows the wielder to deliver a swift slashing attack as if just in passing.

items.name: Fang of Rage
items.description: A refined version of the White Fang. One fell swoop from this silver blade shreds everything in its path in one great surge. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Quietus
items.description: [Players with 1.900RP or Above Only] The technology used in developing the Mana Eater was used to reproduce this magic sword of Fallen Angels. No evil powers seem to course through its blade, despite its ominous appearance. It is a prototype created by a certain defense contractor, and offers powers unimaginable in a commercial product. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Schwarzritter
items.description: Those who wield this sword shall be able to decimate their foes with burning might, like a fire that trails across the earth.

items.name: Hino-Kagutsuchi
items.description: 転生者が手にした、神の化身たる炎の剣。

items.name: Attack Knife
items.description: An orthodox combat knife. A legendary hero is said to have learned how to fight with this knife.

items.name: Athame
items.description: This legendary knife was crafted specially from a special wrought iron and soaked in the powers of the moon for a year by a witch. Used in Modern Witchcraft.

items.name: Combat Knife
items.description: A combat knife used in the army.

items.name: Azoth Sword
items.description: A sword of wisdom forged by the alchemist Paracelsus. A demon is said to be trapped in the crystal imbedded in the hilt.

items.name: Gladius
items.description: A typical sword used by heavy infantrymen and gladiators in ancient Rome.

items.name: Main Gauche
items.description: A dagger used in duels designed to make it easier to parry an enemy's physical attack.

items.name: Wakizashi of Fuma
items.description: A short katana named after the Fuma ninja clan that was based in the Soma Ashigara area during the Sengoku period.

items.name: Kris Naga
items.description: A dagger known as the most beautiful and sharpest in the world.

items.name: Meteoric Dagger
items.description: A dagger forged in a magic ritual from meteoric iron.

items.description: A dagger forged in a magic ritual from meteoric iron. A mysterious power contained within slightly reduces skill cool-down times.

items.name: Meteoric Iron Dagger (Unnatural)
items.description: A dagger forged in a magic ritual from meteoric iron. A mysterious power contained within reduces skill cool-down times.

items.name: Joyeuse
items.description: Charlemagne's personal sword. A holy spear is imbedded in the hilt, causing the blade to change colors 30 times a day.

items.name: Dagger of the Phantom Star
items.description: A dagger crafted from meteoric iron left in extremely high-temperature gas.

items.name: Randall Knife
items.description: A sharp knife with a good grip. Sturdier than it looks, its blade will never grow dull.

items.name: Orna
items.description: the sword of Tethra, king of the Fomorianians. It is said that unsheathing and cleansing the sword will make it tell of its experiences to date.

items.name: Kodachi of Murky Twilight
items.description: A shorter version of the katana that is notable for its ease of use in difficult maneuvers such as jumping at an enemy and delivering a quick thrust.

items.name: Bouquet Rapier
items.description: A rapier graced with a bouquet, made originally for ornamental purposes but perfectly usable as a weapon.

items.name: Trainee Rapier
items.description: [Debug Use] A thrusting sword for training purposes.

items.name: Divide Piercer
items.description: A sword designed for accurately hitting an opponent's weak spot. Its needle-like blade hides the fact that it can easily pierce a thin sheet of metal.

items.name: Blade of the Moonlit Sky
items.description: A dagger that emits a mysterious glow during the New Moon.

items.name: Karaguni
items.description: A dagger named after a Beast that has long lived among fire. Although it looks ordinary, it holds a powerful fire-based magic in its blade.

items.name: Five-Bladed Vajra
items.description: The Heavenly King Zouchouten once owned this weapon, a holy artifact said to represent the Buddha.

items.name: Fireworks (Fire God)
items.description: The perfect remedy for a hot summer night! Just make sure you don't point it at a Jack Frost.

items.name: Tri-Claws
items.description: A sword etched with symbols that make it possible for its wielder to display explosive magical powers.

items.name: Beginner's Knife
items.description: [Players at Level 30 or Below Only] An easy-to-use knife made for newbie Demon Busters. Cannot be traded, sold or stored.

items.name: Eistanzer
items.description: A magical sword said to be able to freeze and steal the soul of those it slashes; and with every swing of its blade, petals of ice and blood fly through the air.

items.name: Miseri Cordis
items.description: [Players with 1.900RP or Above Only] The magic contained within this weapon offers eternal peace to its enemies and explosive life to its allies. It is a prototype created by a certain defense contractor, and offers powers unimaginable in a commercial product. Cannot be traded.

items.name: 桜舞扇（山吹茶）
items.description: ヤマブキイロ。 風を起こして涼をとるだけでなく、礼用や舞踊、 果ては武術や競技にも使われる伝統の道具。

items.name: 桜舞扇（鳶色）
items.description: トビイロ。 風を起こして涼をとるだけでなく、礼用や舞踊、 果ては武術や競技にも使われる伝統の道具。

items.name: 桜舞扇（青藍）
items.description: セイラン。 風を起こして涼をとるだけでなく、礼用や舞踊、 果ては武術や競技にも使われる伝統の道具。

items.name: 桜舞扇（草色）
items.description: クサイロ。 風を起こして涼をとるだけでなく、礼用や舞踊、 果ては武術や競技にも使われる伝統の道具。

items.name: 桜舞扇（菖蒲色）
items.description: ショウブイロ。 風を起こして涼をとるだけでなく、礼用や舞踊、 果ては武術や競技にも使われる伝統の道具。

items.name: Epee
items.description: A sword blessed with powers that increase the strength of its wielder. Many are those who kneel before its godliness.

items.name: Luno Spado
items.description: Death on a moonlit night can be quite glorious, don't you think? So how would you like to be cut? A half moon? Oh very well, then; a crescent moon it is.

items.name: Strain Gauche
items.description: A dueling dagger designed to make the enemy really strain themselves to try to hit you as you nimbly parry their attacks. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Champion's Shaku
items.description: A ritual baton carved from a tree bestowed with royal status due to the special powers it possesses. Those who hold the baton are said to be able to correct their postures and short-term memory problems.

items.name: Kagura Bells
items.description: This Shinto dance accessory contains powers to repel evil and beckon holy spirits. Its soothing sound is said to be able to force the gods themselves to stop and listen.

items.name: Sword Blade
items.description: One of the seven blades of the Seven-Branched Sword. It has lost its powers and turned dark red. It was found in the Suginami Tunnels. Cannot be traded, sold, repaired, or dropped.

items.name: Sword Blade
items.description: One of the seven blades of the Seven-Branched Sword. It has lost its powers and turned dark red. It was found in Shibuya Quartz. Cannot be traded, sold, repaired, or dropped.

items.name: Sword Blade
items.description: One of the seven blades of the Seven-Branched Sword. It has lost its powers and turned dark red. It was found in the Kagurazaka Zhu Que Cavern. Cannot be traded, sold, repaired, or dropped.

items.name: Sword Blade
items.description: One of the seven blades of the Seven-Branched Sword. It has lost its powers and turned dark red. It was found in the Shinagawa Catacomb of the Templar Knights. Cannot be traded, sold, repaired, or dropped.

items.name: Sword Blade
items.description: One of the seven blades of the Seven-Branched Sword. It has lost its powers and turned dark red. It was found in Celu Tower. Cannot be traded, sold, repaired, or dropped.

items.name: Sword Blade
items.description: One of the seven blades of the Seven-Branched Sword. It has lost its powers and turned dark red. It was taken from you by Fei at the Old Ichigaya Camp. Cannot be traded, sold, repaired, or dropped.

items.name: Champion's Shaku (Reverse)
items.description: Shaku made from a tree that possesses special power. It's said that the holder will correct his behavior and will improve one's memory. Special dye is used.

items.name: Kagura Bells (Reverse)
items.description: The Bell possesses the power to cast out the evil and beckons the holy spirit. Even God will listen intently to the purity of the sound. Special dye is used.

items.name: 哭翼の風魔の脇差（緊縛）
items.description: 戦国時代、相模足柄郡に居を構える 忍者・風魔の名を冠した脇差。 その刃を受けたモノは、 泣き叫び、嘆き悲しむと伝えられている。

items.name: Violence Knife
items.description: Knife that was owned by ruler of Shinjuku long ago. It seems that it possesses the power of a guardian.

items.name: 暗躍する情報屋のナイフ
items.description: もう一つのイケブクロに生きる 暗躍する情報屋が持っているナイフ。 それを元に作成したレプリカ。 ある衣装と併せた場合のみ、特殊な力が発揮される。

items.name: Cotton Candy
items.description: A light and fluffy treat oft enjoyed by children with a sweet tooth. If attacked while eating it, you may find yourself in a 窶徭ticky窶・situation!

items.name: Grilled Squid
items.description: Fresh squid grilled over hot coals and covered in soy sauce. Truly a rare delicacy. Be careful not to be attacked while eating it, lest you wind up with ink on your face!

items.name: Buer Scalpel
items.description: The scalpel exclusivly used by Devil Doctor for dissection operation. Somehow, it bore the name of the devil and became the symbol of Devil Doctor.

items.name: Tactical Knife
items.description: Combat knife that can be used at any moment in time of an assault. Once you hold the knife at the ready, you won't be off guard. Expandability is better than the old style.

items.name: Tactical Knife (Old Style)
items.description: Combat knife that can be used at any moment in time of an assault. Once you hold the knife at the ready, you won't be off guard.

items.name: Demonic Cutter
items.description: 使い方は単純。 まず、しっかりとこの突剣を構え、 敵にめがけて素早く振り抜く。 ご褒美に、グロテスクな切り身を見る事ができる。

items.name: フォトン・スラッシャー
items.description: 先進的な光子学を駆使して作られたナイフ。 使用者は重量を感じず扱うことができるので、 素早い攻撃を繰り出すことができる。

items.name: 銀のダガー
items.description: 香津美・リキュールの母、 巫由伽・リキュールが持っていたダガー。

items.name: 銀のダガー＋１
items.description: 香津美・リキュールの母、 巫由伽・リキュールが持っていたダガー。

items.name: 銀のダガー＋２
items.description: 香津美・リキュールの母、 巫由伽・リキュールが持っていたダガー。

items.name: ヴィススティンガー
items.description: 螺旋の力が込められた武器。 湾曲した刃が敵の体を深く抉る。

items.name: Peacock Blade
items.description: 裏高野の退魔師が持つ法具。

items.name: Demonic Cutter (Reverse)
items.description: 使い方は単純。 まず、しっかりとこの突剣を構え、 敵にめがけて素早く振り抜く。 ご褒美に、グロテスクな切り身を見る事ができる。 裏社会で作成されたデモナ・カッターの亜種。

items.name: 小太刀夜隠
items.description: 通常の刀よりも短く作られた刀。 敵の懐に飛び込み鋭い一撃を見舞うなど、 機敏な動作が可能であり、使いまわしの良さが特徴。 使用者の技量次第で、連鎖攻撃を可能とする。

items.name: 燃ゆる短剣
items.description: 熾天使が持つとされる 情熱に満ちた炎の短剣。

items.name: 燃ゆる短剣・神域
items.description: 熾天使が持つとされる 情熱に満ちた炎の短剣。

items.name: 燃ゆる短剣・神託
items.description: 熾天使が持つとされる 情熱に満ちた炎の短剣。

items.name: 凶星・デスパレード
items.description: 「不吉」の意味を持つ小剣。 この剣をもつものは常に不吉が 付きまとうが、これに立ち向かう意志が ある使い手に対して、強大な力を発揮 させる。

items.name: 新緑の落し物（坤）
items.description: 松をイメージした緑色のポチ袋。 封を切り、中をあらためるまで、 何が入っているかわからない。 ※使用することでアイテムと交換が可能。

items.name: 開稲の落し物（坤）
items.description: 竹をイメージした黄色のポチ袋。 封を切り、中をあらためるまで、 何が入っているかわからない。 ※使用することでアイテムと交換が可能。

items.name: 春紅の落し物（坤）
items.description: 梅をイメージした赤色のポチ袋。 封を切り、中をあらためるまで、 何が入っているかわからない。 ※使用することでアイテムと交換が可能。

items.name: クリスマスボックス２０１５
items.description: 蓋を開け、中をあらためるまで、 何が入っているかわからない不思議な箱。 ※使用することでアイテムと交換が可能。

items.name: Spiked Rod
items.description: A primitve weapon composed of a spike attached to the tip of a rod, said to have been used by a legendary hero.

items.name: Morning Star
items.description: A primitve weapon with a Star-shaped tip.

items.name: Battle Hammer
items.description: A simple weapon composed of a heavy block of metal attached at the tip of a rod.

items.name: Dragon Mace
items.description: A mace imbued with the magic powers of dragons.

items.name: Wolf Fang Club
items.description: The weapon used by Qin Ming, one of the characters in the Ming Dynasty novel Water Margin.

items.name: Vajra Mace
items.description: A mace similar in appearance to the Five-Bladed Vajra. Has the power to ward off magic.

items.name: Kingo Rod
items.description: A simple weapon similar in appearance to the scripture-covered rods used by mountain climbers heading for temples. Contains sacred powers.

items.name: Mailbreaker
items.description: A gigantic warhammer capable of even destroying armor.

items.name: Empress Rod
items.description: A rod containing magic, famed as the greatest treasure owned by the Blizzaton Casino.

items.name: Gigantic Metal Club
items.description: A rugged metal club that can only be used by someone with powerful arms. A 2007 Setsubun Event item.

items.name: Mjolnir

items.name: Iron Pipe
items.description: An iron pipe used in construction work, that when wielded gives off a violent mood.

items.name: Snakeman's Rod
items.description: +30 close-range damage. +20 spell damage +31 support effects +5 Critical Hit Rate

items.name: Kabutsuchi Kyoko
items.description: A manly weapon with a head that has been toughened to an incredible degree. A single swing is all it takes to win; there is nothing this weapon cannot break.

items.name: Conviction
items.description: The rod held by the Divine, Principality. The wielder is blessed by the power of the Principalities contained within. While equipped, the wielder can perform the Soul Punish skill.

items.name: Ka-Osho
items.description: the combat rod used by Lu Zhisheng, the wild monk in the Ming Dynasty novel Water Margin.

items.name: Club of Rashomon
items.description: A rough club said to have been owned by an evil oger that once terrorized Kyoto. Those who wield it will find their arms almost bursting with strength.

items.name: Royal Scepter of Demonic Blood
items.description: A combat rod adorned with gems formed from crystallizing the blood of a royal demon. Its magical nature greatly enhances the wielder's magic powers.

items.name: Rod of Panacea
items.description: TBA

items.name: Mara's Vajra
items.description: A sacred tool of the demon Mara with considerable destructive powers. Its nature could turn saintly or demonic depending on who wields it. Increases magic-based damage.

items.name: Warhammer (Silver)
items.description: A hammer customized for use in combating demons. It contains an ancient magic to ward off demons that protects the wielder with the blessings of the gods.

items.name: Warhammer (Bronze)
items.description: A hammer customized for use in combating demons. Mass produced for fighting low-level demons, it can probably still pack a wallop to most demons.

items.name: Steel Claw of the Wolf
items.description: A ridiculously huge club that is a giant version of the Wolf Fang Club. Its destructive powers are as monstrous as one would imagine just by looking at it.

items.name: Red Crystal Rod
items.description: A magical rod adorned with a fiery red jewel that links with the mind of its wielder to improve his or her fire-based powers.

items.name: Clown Mace
items.description: A mace that belonged to a jester who was skilled in magic and conversation. Reduces incantation and cool-down time for spells, allowing for rapid spellcasting.

items.name: Trainee Mace
items.description: [Debug Use] A mace for training purposes.

items.name: Flamehorn
items.description: A red hammer shaped like the horn of an animal and overflowing with fiery powers.

items.name: Vajra
items.description: The Heavenly King Komokuten once owned this weapon, a holy artifact said to represent the Buddha.

items.description: [Players at Level 35 or Below Only] The rod held by Divine, Principality. The wielder is blessed by the power of the Principalities contained within. While equipped, the wielder can perform the Soul Punish skill.

items.description: [Players at Level 35 or Below Only] A red hammer shaped like the horn of an animal and overflowing with fiery powers.

items.name: Mara's Vajra A
items.description: [Players at Level 35 or Below Only] A sacred tool of the demon Mara with considerable destructive powers. Its nature could turn saintly or demonic depending on who wields it.

items.name: Buster Bat
items.description: Listen and tremble!! This bat has been forged from a super alloy and is said to be able to even knock back meteors! Not only that, it'll even make you invincible for 25 minutes!! Eh, I'm just joking, it's a gag item.

items.name: Cloche de Noel
items.description: The solemn gong of this bell rings across the world, banishing all evil in its path. While equipped, the wielder can perform the Bell Attack skill.

items.name: Beginner's Mace
items.description: [Players at Level 30 or Below Only] An easy-to-use mace made for the newbie Demon Buster. Cannot be traded, sold or stored.

items.name: Tangerine Rod
items.description: A staff modified to bring out the full fiery potential of the Red Crystal Rod. Its crimson flames bloom like rose petals as they consume whatever lies before it. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Bloody Six-String (Speed)
items.description: A replica of a guitar soaked in the blood of thousands and once owned by the God of Metal. It has been modified for battle by some of his radical followers.

items.name: Golden Metal Club
items.description: A club cast in a rare metal known as Gold Iron. With this weapon by your side, there's no doubt you can cast aside whatever demons stand in your way. A Setsubun Event item.

items.name: Powerful Gigantic Metal Club
items.description: A rugged metal club that can only be used by someone with powerful arms. Contains the power of Oni. A Setsubun Event item.

items.description: A rugged metal club that can only be used by someone with powerful arms. Contains the magic of Oni. A Setsubun Event item.

items.name: Joyful Gigantic Metal Club
items.description: A rugged metal club that can only be used by someone with powerful arms. Contains the joyous tears of Oni. A Setsubun Event item.

items.name: Sacred Rod
items.description: The jewel encrusted in this rod holds a sacred power. They say the will to protect someone can at times turn into the most powerful weapon. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Thor's Hammer, Mjolnir
items.description: Mjolnir, the hammer of the thunder god, Thor. A seeker who is looking for the genuine power is endowed with the impressive might just like Thunder""

items.name: Golden Strike
items.description: A blunt weapon made of a shiny, gold metal. The material has been processed as little as possible to preserve its qualities.

items.name: Dummy Primitive Weapon A
items.description: It is simple to use. First, you take this blunt weapon and raise high then swing down straight to the enemy's head. Grotesque fireworks can be seen as a reward.

items.name: Electric Guitar: Assault
items.description: Flicking with tooth! Burning in the fire! And beat people with it! That's how guitar is used Yeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeah!!

items.name: Candy Apple Bludgeon
items.description: A monstrous-looking weapon that cruelly tempts its victims with its sweetness into getting clobbered.

items.name: King Frost Wand
items.description: The sacred rod of the lord of frost. Those who wield it have the coldest winds in the world at their command.

items.name: Red Crystal Rod
items.description: A magical rod with a burning-red jewel embedded at its top that increases its master's fire powers whenever its master desires. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Freezing Bell
items.description: A large bell made of a serene, pale-blue metal. When rung, it emits a sublime yet gentle sound that freezes the world into silence.

items.name: Alice's Stick (Happy)
items.description: A stick that is almost similar to a certain mah-jong girl prodigy has.

items.name: Alice's Stick (Secret)
items.description: A stick that is almost similar to a certain mah-jong girl prodigy has.

items.name: プリングルズ　ハンマー
items.description: 世界中で大人気といわれている、 プリングルズのパッケージをアレンジした 可愛らしいハンマー。

items.name: 池袋最強の男の標識
items.description: もう一つのイケブクロに生きる 最強の男が武器として使用した標識。 それを元に作成したレプリカ。 ある衣装と併せた場合のみ、特殊な力が発揮される。

items.name: Stone Slave
items.description: Discovered somewhere in the ruins this club is made out of the most wonderful of stones. Seems plenty powerful as is but the mysterious waves it resonates makes you suspect its power may be even greater than you think.

items.name: Rose Rod
items.description: A rod made for the Queen of the Shadow Country. Increases the power of wielder's magic and impact skills. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Oni's Iron Club
items.description: Only select Oni have these super sadistic weapons. Due to their special make they cannot be repaired by humans. Cannot be traded, repaired or stored.

items.name: Rocking Orbit
items.description: A cudgel awakened from sleep with a mind of its own. An unknown organization can draw greater power from the possessor. However, when the moon is out it will take the all possessor's manners to stop their soul from being instantly destroyed.

items.name: Pumpkin Bunmer (S)
items.description: Saien's secret weapon named after the legendary pun of pumpkin and bun (pot) and hammer. S stands for sample. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Pumpkin Bunmer (N)
items.description: Saien's secret weapon named after the legendary pun of pumpkin and bun (pot) and hammer. N stands for normal. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Pumpkin Bunmer (G)
items.description: Saien's secret weapon named after the legendary pun of pumpkin and bun (pot) and hammer. G stands for great.

items.name: Freelen Empress Rod
items.description: The Empress Rod imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power. Can become even stronger by mixing with Fimbulvet's Sword Crystal (Rod).

items.name: Freelen Empress Rod +1
items.description: The Empress Rod imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power. Can become even stronger by mixing with Fimbulvet's Wolf Crystal (Rod).

items.name: Freelen Empress Rod +2
items.description: The Empress Rod imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power. Can become even stronger by Tarot Fusion with Norn's Crystal and Soul Stone Fusion with Nyx's Crystal.

items.name: Freelen Empress Rod +3
items.description: The Empress Rod imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power. It is at its maximum power.

items.name: Blue Poppy
items.description: A rod made of a blue mineral that has a strange power. That power can remove obstacles from the user's path. All attacks will not be affected by enemy's magical resistance. +200% damage to CLS-R, LNG-R and MAG against the enemy One who reflects the Winter Moon". Increases the number of times you can receive a reward from the Icicle in East Shinagawa Great Ice Hole. It has these abilities b

items.name: トレイニーハンマー
items.description: 扱い易さを重視して作成されたハンマー。

items.name: パイプ椅子
items.description: 酷使されてきたためか、 もはや座ることはできない椅子。 平面で殴られるならまだしも、 カドが当たるとそれなりに痛いかもしれない。

items.name: 釘バット
items.description: 身近な素材で作られているわりに 強烈な威圧効果を得られる武器。 これで殴られると、とても痛そうだ。

items.name: スイカ割り棒
items.description: スイカを割るためだけに生まれてきた棒。 大抵のスイカならやわらかく粉砕する。 棒に染み付いたスイカの汁で棒が 赤く染まった、などという噂が絶えない。

items.name: 金剛軍配
items.description: 敵を畏怖させる特大の軍配。 知勇兼備の猛将だけが、この武器を扱えたという。

items.name: 棒キャンディ
items.description: 持っているとすぐに手がベトベトになる。 お菓子が大好きな悪魔たちの目の前に出せば、 目を輝かせて惹きつけること間違いなし！ 隙だらけのときに打てば、悪魔は幸せな夢を抱いて 昇天することでしょう。

items.name: おいちいキャンディ【火炎】
items.description: 使用者の体に火炎の真理を体現した力が流れ込み、 えも言われぬほどの高揚感に満ちてくる。 イヤ～ッハッハッハッハッハ！！！

items.name: おいちいキャンディ【氷結】
items.description: 使用者の体に氷結の真理を体現した力が流れ込み、 えも言われぬほどの高揚感に満ちてくる。 ンフッフッフッフッフッフッフッ。

items.name: おいちいキャンディ【電撃】
items.description: 使用者の体に電撃の真理を体現した力が流れ込み、 えも言われぬほどの高揚感に満ちてくる。 ウェヘッヘッヘッヘッヘッヘッヘッヘ！！！

items.name: おいちいキャンディ【衝撃】
items.description: 使用者の体に衝撃の真理を体現した力が流れ込み、 えも言われぬほどの高揚感に満ちてくる。 タァハハハハハハ！！！

items.name: おいちいキャンディ【魔力】
items.description: 使用者の体に魔力の真理を体現した力が流れ込み、 えも言われぬほどの高揚感に満ちてくる。 ヒャッハァ～～～～～！！！

items.name: 蒙鷦棒
items.description: Moh Shuvuuを手伝ったお礼に貰った 小さな鳥のついた棒。 どれだけ振り回しても鳥は飛びたたないし くちばしの部分をうまく当てれば、突っつくこともできる！ 何かを叩くには最適だ！

items.name: 超豪邪主破壊棍
items.description: 超強え！　鬼強え！　めっちゃかっけえ！ ただの金棒の百億倍凄え！！

items.name: Angelic Trumpet
items.description: Fiend 楽器と呼ばれる３種の１つ 終末の前に鳴り響くという。

items.name: Angelic Trumpet +1
items.description: Fiend 楽器と呼ばれる３種の１つ 終末の前に鳴り響くという。

items.name: Angelic Trumpet +2
items.description: Fiend 楽器と呼ばれる３種の１つ 終末の前に鳴り響くという。

items.name: Angelic Trumpet +3
items.description: Fiend 楽器と呼ばれる３種の１つ 終末の前に鳴り響くという。

items.name: Stradivari
items.description: Fiend 楽器と呼ばれる３種の１つ 華麗な音色と美しい外観をもつ。

items.name: Stradivari +1
items.description: Fiend 楽器と呼ばれる３種の１つ 華麗な音色と美しい外観をもつ。

items.name: Stradivari +2
items.description: Fiend 楽器と呼ばれる３種の１つ 華麗な音色と美しい外観をもつ。

items.name: Stradivari +3
items.description: Fiend 楽器と呼ばれる３種の１つ 華麗な音色と美しい外観をもつ。

items.name: Two-Handed Sword
items.description: A huge longsword wielded with both hands. Not sold in ordinary shops.

items.name: Kotetsu Blade
items.description: A modern reworking of the classic Kotetsu katana.

items.name: Flamberge
items.description: A large, beautiful sword with a blade shaped like a wavy column of fire, that can dig into wounds and widen them.

items.name: Plasma Sword
items.description: A hi-tech sword made of plasma that is bequeathed to those who join the Templar Knights.

items.name: Valhalla Sword (Red)
items.description: A sword only handed to a chosen warrior among the Valkyrie, warrior maiden of the North.

items.name: Celestial Shotel
items.description: A sword with the lights of the heavens woven in that imbues its wielder with the power of the stars.

items.name: Unknown Sword
items.description: A katana without name that oozes with untapped potential.

items.name: Steelslicer
items.description: A longsword shaped like a chainsaw with the power to split a steel helmet. Difficult to obtain and maintain.

items.name: Claymore
items.description: [LAW Players Only] A huge sword as tall as a grown man. It is said the sword can measure the skill of its wielder, and indicate its judgement in the brightness of the gem embedded in its blade.

items.name: Bloody Luminescence
items.description: [CHAOS Players Only] A hi-tech sword that emits a red glow from the rivers of blood it has absorbed from its enemies.

items.name: Valhalla Sword (Blue)
items.description: A sword only handed to a chosen warrior among the Valkyrie, warrior maiden of the North.

items.name: Harakiri Saber
items.description: [CHAOS Players Only] A sword that is said to have destroyed every opponent with a single swing. The eery glimmer of its blade draws its weilder towards absolute power.

items.name: Zero
items.description: A dark sword that can freeze an enemy with a single touch, thereby killing them without spilling a drop of blood.

items.name: Little Devil's Sickle
items.description: A single swipe of this sickle shall rid the world of fear and the cheating hearts of men.

items.name: Shadow Kogitsunemaru
items.description: The shadow twin to the famous Kogitsunemaru katana. Although its form is not perfect, it is said to have qualitites that are superior to even that of the original.

items.name: Kogitsunemaru
items.description: Crafted by Sanjo Munechika and the incarnation of a god, this mystical sword is said to be able to change the course of lightning itself thanks to its nonhuman craftsmanship.

items.name: Death
items.description: The sword wielded by Chernobog, the Reaper. The horrific dark powers contained wtihin slowly eat up and conquer its weilder. While equipped, the wielder can perform the Lifebreak skill.

items.name: Benediction
items.description: [LAW Players Only] Wielded by the Archangels, this holy sword has been cleansed in holy waters and lined with pure silver, giving it holy powers that can ward off evil.

items.name: Answerer
items.description: The magical sword wielded by Lugh, God of Light. It is said to be able to pierce any armor and bring great fortune to those who find it.

items.name: Hauteclere
items.description: The sword wielded by Olivier, one of Charlemagne's twelve paladins. Having prematurely lost its owner, the sword is still said to be haunted by the sorrow of Olivier.

items.name: Spirit Sword of Bishamonten
items.description: A spiritual sword with a blade imbued with the powers of a fierce god of war. Its dazzling blade emits a demonic glimmer as it slices its enemy.

items.name: Harakiri Saber (Speed)
items.description: A well-made imitation of a Harakiri Saber. It looks exactly like a Harakiri Saber, but because it was made differently, its functions are completely different as well.

items.name: Plasma Sword (Speed)
items.description: A well-made imitation of a Plasma Sword. It looks exactly like a Plasma Sword, but because it was made differently, its functions are completely different as well.

items.name: Claymore (Heavy)
items.description: A well-made imitation of a Claymore. It looks exactly like a Claymore, but because it was made differently, its functions are completely different as well.

items.name: Demonslayer
items.description: A steel sword crafted by a famous smith. the yin to the Godslayer's yang. While equipped, the wielder can perform the Yamatoji Style: Throw skill.

items.name: Godslayer
items.description: A steel sword crafted by a famous smith. the yang to the Demonslayer's yin. While equipped, the wielder can perform the Yamatoji Style: Thrust skill.

items.name: Swallowtail
items.description: A longsword with a sharp blade. Having been specially crafted in an unknown workshop for its original owner, no one else can ever hope to handle it properly.

items.name: SACHE
items.description: A humongous longsword that can toss aside and destroy any enemy. Although it packs a huge punch, its weight makes it difficult to use.

items.name: Wild Jester
items.description: A sword that holds a secret wild card. The magic in the onyx weaved into the blade can transport the wielder and the enemy to an empty void. While equipped, the wielder can perform the Dimensional Laceration skill.

items.name: Kotetsu II
items.description: The sword wielded by Ogami. The name engraved on its blade indicates it to be a famous Kotetsu katana.

items.name: Circulator
items.description: The hilt of this sword is equipped with a device that absorbs excess magic when a spell is cast, allowing the wielder to cast spells more efficiently.

items.name: Zero S
items.description: A mystical sword that can freeze an enemy with a single touch, thereby killing them without spilling a drop of blood. Cannot be traded, sold or repaired.

items.name: Sword of Bishamonten S
items.description: A spiritual sword with a blade imbued with the powers of a fierce god of war. Its dazzling blade emits a demonic glimmer as it slices its enemy. Cannot be traded, sold or repaired.

items.name: Cursebringer
items.description: A sword crafted by a mad genius who was scorned and alienated by others. It has since grown in size by feeding on grudges, beginning with its maker's. Increases death-based damage.

items.name: Thunder's Edge
items.description: A sword imbued with the powers of lightning. Skilled swordsmen can overwhelm their opponent with lightning-fast attacks. Increases electric-based damage.

items.name: Silverblade of the Heavens
items.description: A spiritual sword that, as it swings through the air, produces an afterimage that looks like a shooting star flying to the heavens. Increases magic-based damage.

items.name: Large Steelslicer
items.description: [Players at Level 60 or Above Only] A large slicer so heavy that swinging it down can even steel and evil and has more revolution than that of Steelslicer.

items.name: Comet Sweeper
items.description: A witch's broom said to fly faster than a comet and be able to sweep up even the shards of the stars.

items.name: Pumpkin Sickle
items.description: An enormous sickle decorated with Halloween motifs. Its lighthearted appearance hides an incredibly dangerous sharpness. While equipped, the wielder can perform the Bloody Attack skill.

items.name: Shadowslash
items.description: Just as there is shadow where there is light, this katana exists as the shadow version of the Demonslayer and Godslayer. Pierces through flesh with ease, like a shadow that melts into the space between two objects.

items.name: Muramasa
items.description: [Players at Level 80 or Above Only] A magical blade that has the blood of three generations of rulers on its cursed blade. Although the wielder is endowed with earth-shattering might, both wielder and ally are cursed forever more.

items.name: Zero A
items.description: [Players at Level 35 or Below Only] A mystical sword that can freeze an enemy with a single touch, thereby killing them without spilling a drop of blood.

items.name: Death A
items.description: [Players at Level 35 or Below Only] The sword wielded by Chernobog, the Reaper. The horrific dark powers contained within slowly eat up and conquer its wielder. While equipped, the wielder can perform the Lifebreak skill.

items.name: Sparrowblade
items.description: This feather-weight blade swoops through the air at such speeds as to leave its victim tattered in moments, as if attacked by a flock of raptors.

items.name: Candystick
items.description: A weapon created by coating a hard pretzel with sweet chocolate.

items.name: Candystick
items.description: A weapon created by coating a hard pretzel with sweet chocolate. Strawberry flavor.

items.name: Candystick
items.description: A weapon created by coating a hard pretzel with sweet chocolate. Milk flavor.

items.name: Cold Strike of Death
items.description: A sword that can create a blade of ice by draining the cold from the air. The blade is so cold enemies would rather take their own lives than face it.

items.name: Flamesword of the Vanguard
items.description: Used to contain the fires of the demonic city of Makai, the blade is still hot with the heat from the flames.

items.name: Cosmopolitan Sword
items.description: A sword crafted to sever the roots of the matrices of hate and bitterness that plague the world.

items.name: Executer
items.description: An onyx two-handed sword designed to punish those who have wandered off the path of righteousness.

items.name: Kotetsu: Red
items.description: A Kotetsu Blade imbued with the powers of nature. A Spirit of Fire resides within its blade.

items.name: Kotetsu: Stream
items.description: A Kotetsu Blade imbued with the powers of nature. A Spirit of Ice resides within its blade.

items.name: Kotetsu: Thunder
items.description: A Kotetsu Blade imbued with the powers of nature. A Spirit of Lightning resides within its blade.

items.name: Kotetsu: Kite
items.description: A Kotetsu Blade imbued with the powers of nature. A Spirit of the Winds resides within its blade.

items.name: Orcrist
items.description: A two-handed sword designed for combat against much larger foes than yourself. All that is vile shall cower before it.

items.name: Midgardsormr
items.description: Also known as the Serpent Sword, the power displayed by this weapon is so monstrous, it could bring about the end of the world. Its shape seems to suggest an immense serpent releasing its tail from the clutches of its own jaw.

items.name: Laevateinn
items.description: Said to be the Sword of Fire wielded by the Lord of all Demons, this weapon is capable of burning down the whole world with a single swing.

items.name: Sword of Incarceration
items.description: Sword that can kill the enemy with one strike

items.name: Suno Glavo
items.description: A sword crafted somewhere in Europe, designed to strike down enemies in vertical arcs, like a blunt weapon.

items.name: Hate of the Neckchopper
items.description: When will you use your hate ? This is no treasure box for saving your bullions. If you see what we mean, wield this sickle with power.

items.name: Black Jester
items.description: A sword that does not hold a secret wild card. The magic in the onyx weaved into the blade hopefully transports the wielder and the enemy to an empty void. While equipped, but unforunately the wielder cannot perform the Dimensional Laceration skill. Cannot be traded

items.name: Sparrowblade
items.description: This feather-weight blade swoops through the air at such speeds as to leave its victim tattered in moments, as if attacked by a flock of raptors. Cannot be traded

items.name: Sword of Purgatory
items.description: A spiritual sword imbued with a large dose of Hecatonchires' magic.

items.name: Broken Seven-Branched Sword
items.description: A Seven-Branched Sword with 6 blades missing, found deep inside the Shibuya Underpass. Although said to have been handed down to earth by the Heavenly Gods and be capable of slicing through evil, shattering the darkness, and repelling magic, it has lost its powers and has turned dark red. According to Sukunahikona, it glows when communicating with lost souls. Cannot be traded, sold, repaired, or dropped.

items.name: Seven-Branched Sword
items.description: A Seven-Branched Sword sold to you by the Grandpa in Souhonzan. It is said to have been handed down to earth by the Heavenly Gods and be capable of slicing through evil, shattering the darkness, and repelling magic. It is a family heirloom, and certainly looks impressive; but is it the real thing? Cannot be traded or sold.

items.name: Flammeberge
items.description: A large, beautiful sword with a scarlet blade shaped like a wavy column of fire that bring one's enemies closer to death by scorching their wounds.

items.name: Crusader's Claymore
items.description: A two-handed sword crafted out of a Claymore and designed to destroy those who stand up to God. It has a sharp, rugged but elegant blade that will decimate even the wretched and the impure. Cannot be traded or repaired.

items.name: Decapitation Saber
items.description: A two-handed sword crafted from a Harakiri Saber and designed to weed out the weak from this world. Its astonishingly extended blade can put an end to the worries of any foe, as well as their lives. Cannot be traded or repaired.

items.name: Crimson Luminescence
items.description: A two-handed sword crafted from a Bloody Luminescence and designed to weed out the weak from this world. Its blade has turned black from all the blood it has spilled. Cannot be traded or repaired.

items.name: Cold Strike of Death (Destruction)
items.description: A sword that can create a blade of ice by draining the cold from the air. The blade is so cold enemies would rather take their own lives than face it.

items.name: アーベントイヤー（破壊）
items.description: 魔界の炎を封じ込めている為、 刀身が異常に肥大化した剣。 特殊な改修が施されており、 全ての物を壊し尽くす力を持っている。

items.name: Ｈ・Ｏ・ネックチョッパー（破壊）
items.description: 貴様の憎しみはいつ使うんだ。 いつか使う為に貯めている 貯金箱じゃないんだ。 さぁ、わかったらさっさとこの鎌を握れ。 特殊な改修が施されており、 全ての物を壊し尽くす力を持っている。

items.name: Sword of Heaven and Earth
items.description: One-of-a-kind sword that shines brighter than anything of this world. It's said that there's nothing this blade can't cut. When Majesty COMP or Majesty COMP Alpha and Majesty COMP (Modified) are equipped +5% chance of Limit Break +10% Limit Break damage

items.name: 天上天下（万能・１日）
items.description: 広き世界の中で、唯一つ限りのきらめきを放つ剣。 研ぎ澄まされたその刃には、斬れぬものはないという。

items.name: Tenjo Tenge (Almighty  3 Days)
items.description: A dazzling sword of limitless power its blade is said to be able to slice the heavens. Cannot be traded.

items.name: 天上天下（万能・７日）
items.description: 広き世界の中で、唯一つ限りのきらめきを放つ剣。 研ぎ澄まされたその刃には、斬れぬものはないという。

items.name: Chaos Hero Blade
items.description: Katana that was carried by a boy who devoted to seek power. The strong desire for power makes you want to destroy.

items.name: Demonic Breaker
items.description: It is simple to use. First you take 2-Handed Sword and raise high then swing down straight to the enemy's head. Grotesque section can be seen as a reward.

items.name: 大人しき美少女の罪歌
items.description: もう一つのイケブクロに生きる 浮世離れした少女が持つ刀。 それを元に作成したレプリカ。 ある衣装と併せた場合のみ、 特殊な力が発揮される。

items.name: Ruptured Edge
items.description: A dastardly sword filled with malice by an ancient magician and a master blacksmith. Any who cross blades with it are overwhelmed by an incredible sense of hatred and loathing. Landing consecutive blows on an enemy results in a 20% chance of inflicting that enemy with 窶徘aralysis.窶・ Special abilities cannot be transferred via Soul Fusion, etc.

items.name: Tetsuko Blade
items.description: What did you think this was a Kotetsu blade!?

items.name: Hearty-Beaty Sword
items.description: A sword once held by the warrioress Harikiri it is often given to soldiers with short tempers. Due to its heavy weight those who wield it are rarely excited. However such lackadaisical feelings vanish when it is swung around <b

items.name: Cross Sword
items.description: A unique 2-handed blade specially matched up with a holy symbol. When combined with the courage of the user, the sword's divine power will strike with reverberations of hope. If the Priest's Rosario(M) or Priestess's Rosario(F) is equipped simultaneously, +5% chance of Limit Break +10% Limit Break damage.

items.name: Kotetsu II (Worship God)
items.description: The sword wielded by Ogami. The name engraved on its blade indicates it to be a famous Kotetsu katana. It has an ominous aura.

items.name: Reaper's Sickle
items.description: The sickle owned by a Reaper. With a sharp crescent blade it separates opponent's from their lives. When equipped with the Reaper Eyepatch(M), Reaper Clothes(M), Reaper Talons(M) and Reaper Undergarments(M) at the same time or when equipped with Reaper Eyepatch(F), Reaper Clothes(F), Reaper Talons(F) and Reaper Undergarments(F) at the same time fire skills +LV 0.3% Ice skills up LVx0.3%

items.name: Lost Owner
items.description: Manufacturing date unknown. Creator unknown. Use unknown. Previous owner unknown. No one knows why or for who this suspicious sickle exists. But the great power you feel when you hold it proves that it is an excellent weapon. 5% chance of increases attack damage by 10%. It has these abilities but they cannot be transferred via Soul Fusion, etc.

items.name: Outbreak
items.description: A two handed sword remodeled to increase damage. Uses magnetite as an energy source and holds powers yet to be seen. Temporarily learn the skill Deadly Break". It has these abilities but they cannot be transferred via Soul Fusion

items.name: ブライトワールド
items.description: 闇を払うと云われる剣。 だが、輝きはまだ失われたまま。 ※取得してから５０日間使用可能。

items.name: ブライトワールド＋
items.description: 闇を払うと云われる剣。 輝きを取り戻し始めている。 スキル『プリズムソード』を 一時的に習得するが、 異界新宿バベルの「扉」に進入した場合、 使用可能になる。 ※ダンジョン内からの離脱、 　ログアウトを行うまで、効果は持続する。 ※取得してから５０日間使用可能。

items.name: ブライトワールド＋＋
items.description: 闇を払うと云われる剣。 輝きを完全に取り戻した幻想的な姿。 スキル『プリズムソード』を 一時的に習得するが、 異界新宿バベルの「扉」に進入した場合、 使用可能になる。 『プリズムソード』の、装填数＋１ ※ダンジョン内からの離脱、 　ログアウトを行うまで、効果は持続する。 ※取得してから５０日間使用可能。

items.name: オニマルセイバー
items.description: 「名刀鬼丸」に似せた現代刀。 最先端の混合金属を用いることで、 切れ味が増している。 ※装備すると、通常時の 　待機モーションと移動モーションが変化する。 ※他の、モーションが変わるアイテムを 　同時に装備している場合、組み合わせによっては 　このアイテムのモーションは適用されない。

items.name: True オニマルセイバー
items.description: 「名刀鬼丸」に似せた現代刀。 最先端の混合金属を用いることで、 切れ味が増している。 さらに、練磨したことで 本来以上の力が引き出されている。 ※装備すると、通常時の 　待機モーションと移動モーションが変化する。 ※他の、モーションが変わるアイテムを 　同時に装備している場合、組み合わせによっては 　このアイテムのモーションは適用されない。

items.name: 冥府の鎌
items.description: 冥府への使者が持つとされる鎌。 弧月の鋭い刃で、相手の生を分かつ。

items.name: ディスオーナー
items.description: 製造時期不明。製作者不明。 使用用途不明。元・所有者不明。 何の為に、誰の為に存在するのか 知る者は居ない妖しい鎌。 だが、手にすると伝わってくる大きな力は、 優れた武器だという事を証明している。

items.name: ブライトワールド・アナザー
items.description: 深淵の闇を払う為に作られた輝く剣。

items.name: 絶命Ⅱ（破壊）
items.description: 冷気を圧縮・高圧噴出させることにより、 さらに刀身を伸長することに成功した妖刀。 迸る冷気は、自らの命すら奪いかねない。 さらなる改により、 あらゆる物を破壊し尽くす力を持っている。

items.name: ＨＯネックチョッパーⅡ（破壊）
items.description: 貴様の憎しみはいつ使うんだ。 いつか使う為に貯めている 貯金箱じゃないんだ。 さぁ、わかったらさっさとこの鎌を握れ。 さらなる改修により、 あらゆる物を破壊し尽くす力を持っている。

items.name: Spear
items.description: An ordinary spear with a sharp tip.

items.name: Jiabo
items.description: A spear with a snake-like tip wielded by Zhang Fei, a hero during the Three Kingdoms era.

items.name: Trident
items.description: A three-pronged spear that is a symbol of Poseiden, Greek god of the seas.

items.name: Lance of Longinus
items.description: A spear that became a holy artifact when it was used to pierce a holy man who was crucified on the hills of Golgotha.

items.name: Spear of Duftach
items.description: A demonic spear with powers that have been sealed with sleeping grass. It shoots out flames on its own will and lets out a howl as its wielder charges into battle.

items.name: Lance of Vitality
items.description: A demonic spear that accurately pierces an enemy's weak spot.

items.name: Wild Spear
items.description: A spear that looks primitive with its stone tip.

items.name: Cross-Shaped Spear
items.description: [Players at Level 30 or Above Only] A spear with small blades jutting out both sides of the tip. A lot of practice is needed to master this weapon.

items.name: Spear of Naga
items.description: TBA

items.name: Spear of Magma
items.description: [CHAOS Players Only] A demonic spear imbued with the heat of searing lava.

items.name: Spear of Romulus
items.description: The lance wielded in numerous battles by Romulus, the man who built Rome. It is said to have turned into a giant tree when it was thrust into Palatine Hill.

items.name: Screw Lance
items.description: [Players at Level 40 or Above Only] A heavy mechanical lance created from a drill used for digging into the bedrock. Although it can pierce an enemy's armor and drill into its flesh, its weight makes it difficult for most people to use.

items.name: Lance of the Paladin
items.description: [LAW Players Only] A modified Vital Lance given out to members of the Knights Templar.

items.name: Spear of Mangus
items.description: The lance wielded by the famed chieftain Mangus. Those who wield this weapon are considered the finest warriors.

items.name: Gae Bolg
items.description: The lance bequeathed to the Demigod Cu Chulainn by the Goddess Scathach. Those who wield it gain enormous power in exchange for a heavy sadness. While equipped, the weilder can perform the Gae Bolg skill.

items.name: Hyoshito
items.description: The lance wielded by Lin Chong, a hero from the Ming Dynasty novel Water Margin.

items.name: Hitentaisei
items.description: The lance wielded by Li Gun, a hero from the Ming Dynasty novel Water Margin.

items.name: Poliahu
items.description: A lance blessed by the goddess of snow. The cold air it produces is said to be able to instantly freeze boiling magma.

items.name: Longinus (Speed)
items.description: A well-made imitation of a Longinus. It looks exactly like a Longinus, but because it was made differently, its functions are completely different as well.

items.name: Lance of Vitality (Heavy)
items.description: A well-made imitation of a Vital Lance, It looks exactly like a Vital Lance, but because it was made differently, its functions are completely different as well.

items.name: Spear of Magma (Magic)
items.description: A well-made imitation of a Spear of Magma. It looks exactly like a Spear of Magma, but because it was made differently, its functions are completely different as well.

items.name: Mistilteinn
items.description: A demonic lance that gained a reputaion as a godslayer when it was used to kill Baldur, the Nordic God of Light. It is said to always return to the hand of its owner, no matter how far away.

items.name: Armorpiercer
items.description: A giant lance that can pierce through even the toughest armor. It is said only a select few powerful soliders were able to handle this weapon.

items.name: Crimson Dust of Death
items.description: An accursed crimson lance created by a wizard who reincarnated into this world from Demonic City.

items.name: Caladbolg
items.description: A heavy lance with a name that translates into "Hard Scabbard" that was wielded by Cu Chulainn's friend Fergus. A single blow with this weapon is said to be able to split a hill down the middle.

items.name: Grand Partisan
items.description: [NEUTRAL Players Only] [Players at Level 30 or Above Only] A large lance that can inspire allies fighting for a cause. The large spikes that extend from the tip make it effective for attacking the enemy as well as making them cower.

items.name: Stormpiercer
items.description: A magical lance with wind woven into its tip. A single swing can produce several winds that will rip into the enemy.

items.name: Demonic Crater
items.description: 使い方は単純。 まず、思いっきり鈍器を持ち上げ 敵の脳天めがけて振りきる。 ご褒美に、芳しい香りを楽しむ事ができる。

items.name: Stormpiercer S
items.description: A magical lance with wind woven into its tip. A single swing can produce several winds that will rip into the enemy. Cannot be traded, sold or repaired.

items.name: Three-Bladed Vajra
items.description: The Heavenly King Bishamonten once owned this weapon, a holy artifact said to represent the Buddha.

items.name: Magnum Injection
items.description: This lance's ridiculously large size is enough to make any sensible person become overwhelmed with terror.

items.name: Great Spear of Mangus
items.description: [Players at Level 40 or Above Only] A little-known weapon wielded by the great chieftain Mangus, said to have been used only when his people were endangered by a formidable threat.

items.name: Serpentine Destructor
items.description: [Players at Level 30 or Above Only] A powerful spear once wielded by Zhang Fei, the Great Tiger of Protection. Some say it is still imbued with the impressive might he was known for throughout the kingdom of Shu Han.

items.name: Inhuman Howl
items.description: [Players at Level 70 or Above Only] The moment this spear thrusts through the air, a howl rings out from an unknown location. The source of this howl is unknown, but it is certainly one of the most disturbing sounds known to mankind.

items.name: Phlegethon
items.description: [Players at Level 81 or Above Only] A spear formed out of the magma produced by the flames of Hell. A constant stream of fire flows out of the tip of this weapon, like the river it is named after.

items.name: Poseidon's Trident
items.description: [Players at Level 81 or Above] The trident wielded by Poseidon, ruler of the seas. Said to be able to produce a stream if struck into the earth and freeze the soul if struck into an enemy.

items.name: White Shark
items.description: [Players with 1.300RP or Above Only] A heretical spear, its tip implanted with the tissue of an artificially created demon. It is a prototype created by a certain defense contractor, and offers powers unimaginable in a commercial product. Difficult to upgrade. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Spear of Wave and Wind
items.description: A wild wave and wind, think therefore I am

items.name: Last Judgment
items.description: Residing in your body is a white demon, whose sweet temptations you must be pure of heart to resist. "You are not alone" the spear whispers. "We can overcome this together"

items.name: Joulupukki
items.description: A weapon crafted by Nicholas. The energy contained within can tear through Impenetrable Fields. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Spear of Duftach
items.description: A demonic spear with powers that have been sealed with sleeping grass. It shoots out flames on its own will and lets out a howl as its wielder charges into battle Cannot be traded

items.name: Lance of the Paladin (Imperial)
items.description: A two-handed sword crafted out of a Lance of the Paladin and designed to destroy those who stand up to God. Its tip will pierce through any foe that puts a Messian's life at risk. Cannot be traded or repaired.

items.name: Spear of the Inferno
items.description: A two-handed sword crafted from a Spear of Magma and designed to weed out the weak from this world. It has been forged in fires so hot, it singes its wielder and burns its victims into ash. Cannot be traded or repaired.

items.name: Berial's Wiper
items.description: This wiper was originally made to clean the floor but after it was given a demonic name, it has possessed one hell of a power. Don't know exactly why but it is said that depending on the demon's friendship level, your strength will increase.

items.name: Last Judgment (Destruction)
items.description: Residing in your body is a white demon, whose sweet temptations you must be pure of heart to resist. "You are not alone" the spear whispers. "We can overcome this together" A special repair is given and it has power to destroy everything..

items.name: Focus Lance
items.description: Spear created in the image of the devil. People become frightened when they see the nail in the center.

items.name: UB White Shark
items.description: A heretical spear its tip implanted with the tissue of an artificially created demon. It is a prototype created by a certain defense contractor and offers powers unimaginable in a commercial product.Very difficult to upgrade.

items.name: Hideous Lance
items.description: A prototype created during the development of 窶廛eathbringer,窶・many soldiers were able to claim easy victories with this demon spear's awesome power. However, in the middle of a training mission, the spear's cruel appearance and untamed power went out of control, obliterating the spirit of all those nearby. Landing consecutive blows on an enemy results in a 20% chance of inflicting that enemy with 窶彡harm.窶・ Special abilities cannot be transferred via Soul Fusion, etc.

items.name: Demonic Piercer
items.description: It is simple to use. First, you take spiere and raise high then swing down straight to the enemy's head. A clear hole can be seen as a reward.

items.name: Savage Dog Lance
items.description: A lance made for the one called the Clan's Savage Dog. Increases the user's strength and weapon skills. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Western Pilgrimage
items.description: Containing the essence of a past time this halberd can even make a continent's soldiers surrender. Of use when travelling to other countries.

items.name: Freelen Paladin Lance
items.description: Paladin's lance imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power. Can become even stronger by mixing with Fimbulvet's Sword Crystal (Lance).

items.name: Freelen Paladin Lance +1
items.description: Paladin's lance imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power. Can become even stronger by mixing with Fimbulvet's Wolf Crystal (Lance).

items.name: Freelen Paladin Lance +2
items.description: Paladin's lance imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power. Can become even stronger by Tarot Fusion with Norn's Crystal and Soul Stone Fusion with Nyx's Crystal.

items.name: Freelen Paladin Lance +3
items.description: Paladin's lance imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power. It is at its maximum power.

items.name: Dark Steel Halberd
items.description: This lance was made from corrupt steel that was used in the purification of the armor for the offering to Hades. Good at continuous attacks and one hit kills. Temporarily learn the skill Double Thrust". Temporarily learn the skill "Head Hunt". It has these abilities but they cannot be transferred via Soul Fusion

items.name: 緋扇槍
items.description: 魔界より転生した導士が作ったと云われる 赤色に染まる大刃がついた紅の槍。

items.name: レプンカムイ
items.description: 幾多の戦場を駆け抜けた手だれの戦士にのみ 扱うことができると謂われる槍。 その切っ先はあらゆる物を貫く。

items.name: ムソウイチモンジ
items.description: その昔、存在した高名な刀工の 作品を元に作られた武器。 最先端の混合金属を用いることで、 切れ味が増している。

items.name: True ムソウイチモンジ
items.description: その昔、存在した高名な刀工の 作品を元に作られた武器。 最先端の混合金属を用いることで、 切れ味が増している。 さらに、練磨したことで 本来以上の力が引き出されている。

items.name: ラストジャッジメントⅡ（破壊）
items.description: 体に宿る白い悪魔。 その誘惑に負けまいとする純粋な心。 君は一人じゃない。この槍が囁く。 これを境に乗り越えろ。 さらなる改修により、 あらゆる物を破壊し尽くす力を持っている。

items.name: ヴィスペネトレイター
items.description: 螺旋の力が込められた武器。 両先端についた刃が敵を切り刻む。

items.name: 剣帝ジェッソ
items.description: 魔導士ギルドとともに妖魔と 戦い抜いてきた魔剣。 使いこなす者によっては 剣皇グロスポリナーに 匹敵する力を発揮する。

items.name: 西方行脚・紅蓮式
items.description: かつてあった時代のエッセンスを取り入れた 大陸の兵すら屈服させる薙刀。 国外へ遠征する際に用いたという。 火炎の力が備わっている。

items.name: 西方行脚・雷電式
items.description: かつてあった時代のエッセンスを取り入れた 大陸の兵すら屈服させる薙刀。 国外へ遠征する際に用いたという。 電撃の力が備わっている。

items.name: 孔雀の錫杖
items.description: 裏高野の退魔師が持つ法具。

items.name: マンイーター
items.description: 異常なほど巨大な刃を付けた槍。 使用者の技量次第で、連鎖攻撃を可能とする。

items.name: 蒼扇槍
items.description: 魔界より転生した導士が作ったと云われる 青色に染まる大刃がついた蒼の槍。

items.name: 荒法師の薙刀
items.description: 源義経の郎党の僧兵が持っていた薙刀のレプリカ。 ※装備すると、通常時の待機モーション 　及び、戦闘時の待機モーションが変化する。 ※他の、モーションが変わるアイテムを 　同時に装備している場合、組み合わせによっては 　このアイテムのモーションは適用されない。

items.name: 荒法師の薙刀・弐
items.description: 源義経の郎党の僧兵が持っていた薙刀のレプリカ。 ※装備すると、通常時の待機モーション 　及び、戦闘時の待機モーションが変化する。 ※他の、モーションが変わるアイテムを 　同時に装備している場合、組み合わせによっては 　このアイテムのモーションは適用されない。

items.name: 荒法師の薙刀・参
items.description: 源義経の郎党の僧兵が持っていた薙刀のレプリカ。 ※装備すると、通常時の待機モーション 　及び、戦闘時の待機モーションが変化する。 ※他の、モーションが変わるアイテムを 　同時に装備している場合、組み合わせによっては 　このアイテムのモーションは適用されない。

items.name: 荒法師の薙刀・肆
items.description: 源義経の郎党の僧兵が持っていた薙刀のレプリカ。 ※装備すると、通常時の待機モーション 　及び、戦闘時の待機モーションが変化する。 ※他の、モーションが変わるアイテムを 　同時に装備している場合、組み合わせによっては 　このアイテムのモーションは適用されない。

items.name: Flame Banner
items.description: 熾天使が持つとされる 愛情に満ちた炎の旗。

items.name: Flame Banner - Unity
items.description: 熾天使が持つとされる 愛情に満ちた炎の旗。

items.name: Flame Banner - Guidance
items.description: 熾天使が持つとされる 愛情に満ちた炎の旗。

items.name: Demonic Penetrator (Reverse)
items.description: 使い方は単純。 まず、両手でこの槍をしっかりと持ち、 敵にめがけて真っ直ぐに突き刺す。 ご褒美に、綺麗な風穴を見る事ができる。 裏社会で作成されたデモナ・ペネトレイターの亜種。

items.name: スイカランス
items.description: なぜか先端にスイカの切り身を つけてしまったランス。 スイカには塩派です。

items.name: ハイパー・スイカランス
items.description: なぜか先端にスイカの切り身を つけてしまったランス。 バージョンアップしている。 スイカには砂糖派です。

items.name: イェーガーランス
items.description: 脅威の攻撃力を秘めた 命を狩る者が持つ魔槍。

items.name: Mail-Order Axe
items.description: An ordinary wood axe sold through mail-order.

items.name: Heixuanfeng
items.description: This axe was wielded by Li Kui, the hotheaded chieftain from the Ming Dynasty novel Water Margin.

items.name: Bloodsucker
items.description: An axe shrouded in magic powers that absorbs the life of its wielder while making it easier to deliver Critical Hits.

items.name: Hecaton Axe
items.description: The axe wielded by 50-headed, 100-armed Titan in Greek mythology. Those who wield this weapon will develop steel-like muscles.

items.name: Guillotine Axe
items.description: An executioner's axe wielded by a monster in the Realm of the Vajra Gods.

items.name: Crescent Axe
items.description: An axe created with the power of the moon in a magic ritual.

items.name: Headhunter's Spoon
items.description: A cursed weapon with a device for cutting the heads of enemies installed at the tip. The wielder gains considerable power by sacrificing their own body.

items.name: Pestle of Sacred Wood
items.description: Happy New Year!

items.name: Thunder Fang
items.description: Lightning was used to repeatedly forge and cast the refined iron used to make this axe. It casts bolt after bolt of lightning until the enemy has been turned into ash.

items.name: Floral Whirlwind
items.description: Opening out gracefully like the petals of a large flower, this blade slashes across the enemy, scattering blood-red petals all around.

items.name: Deathbringer
items.description: An axe of death that feeds on the life of its wielder. Those lacking a strong heart will soon lose their soul and flesh to this weapon.

items.name: Glowing Swallowtail
items.description: Despite its beautiful design based on a swallowtail butterfly, this battle axe has been imbued with magic and destructive powers that can rip the air apart.

items.name: Deathbringer (Wheel of Life)
items.description: An axe of death that feeds on the life of its wielder. Those lacking a strong heart will soon lose their soul and flesh to this weapon.

items.name: Axe of Pluto
items.description: [Players at Level 60 or Above Only] A cursed axe that has been refined in the deepest pits of hell and is powerful enough to lift the minds of the wielder's allies out of this world.

items.name: Agony Mantis
items.description: [Players at Level 30 or Above Only] An axe with a blade that has been elongated to deliver the kind of pain that very few would be able to withstand.

items.name: Butterfly of the Parhelion
items.description: A battle axe designed after a butterfly that is said only appear on nights when a sundog can be seen.

items.name: Tabar
items.description: An ancient battle axe with an unusual double-edged crescent blade. Even the handle is made of metal, giving it huge destructive power.

items.name: Glowing Swallowtail A
items.description: [Players at Level 35 or Lower Only] Despite its beautiful design based on a swallowtail butterfly, this battle axe has been imbued with magic and destructive powers that can rip the air apart.

items.name: Thunder Fang A
items.description: [Players at Level 35 or Lower Only] Lightning was used to repeatedly forge and cast the refined iron used to make this axe. It casts bolt after bolt of lightning until the enemy has been turned into ash.

items.name: Axe of Catastrophe
items.description: [Players at Level 70 or Above Only] An axe of destruction forged by a Grand Wizard who went mad upon succumbing to the Dark Side. Four different Elementals are trapped within, making it too fragile to use in close combat.

items.name: Soulhunter's Spoon
items.description: A spoon which has has severed the heads of over 1000 enemies, and has become a cursed weapon that eats away at the wielder's soul. Although the wielder gains fierce Strength, his body and spirit become brittle like a rotten tree.

items.name: Schmetterling
items.description: An axe with a blade modeled on the wings of a butterfly that glows from the magic within. The energy it scatters with every swing energizes all that it touches.

items.name: Golden Pestle
items.description: Happy New Year! The golden sheen of this pestle evokes a celebratory atmosphere.

items.name: Heavenbent Earthshaker
items.description: Turning at high speeds, this blade is said to be capable of shaking the Earth and tearing through the heavens themselves.

items.name: Mana Eater
items.description: [Players with 1.300RP or Above Only] A weapon developed as an attempt to recreate the Deathbringer with human hands, following a detailed analysis of its structure. It is a prototype created by a certain defense contractor, and offers powers unimaginable in a commercial product. Difficult to upgrade. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Helmbreaker
items.description: Awed at the fearsome might of this weapon, capable of smashing in head and helm in one blow, the people soon began calling it by this name.

items.name: Papillon Diabolos
items.description: An axe that glitters from the magic within, with a blade shaped like the wings of a butterfly. Energy scatters off the blade like butterfly scales, vitalizing the area around it. Cannot be traded.

items.name: 哭翼の黒旋風（緊縛）
items.description: 明の時代に書かれた小説「水滸伝」の 無頼漢、天殺星の李逵が愛用した斧。 その刃を受けたモノは、 泣き叫び、嘆き悲しむと伝えられている。

items.name: Black Whirlwind (Fierce Attack)
items.description: Inspired from the classic novel [Water Margin] written during the Ming Dynasty this is Li Kui's favorite axe. You can feel your ferocity grow stronger as you hold it in your hands.

items.name: 黒旋風【猛攻・廉】
items.description: 明の時代に書かれた小説「水滸伝」の 無頼漢、天殺星の李逵が愛用した斧。 手に持つ事で猛々しさが少し増す。

items.name: Black Heaven Comet
items.description: An axe said to be made by a mechanic worker who continued to make it by the light of a firefly on snow even as he was losing his eyesight.

items.name: Demonic Destroyer
items.description: 使い方は単純。 まず、頭上高くこの斧を振り上げ、 敵にめがけて真っ直ぐに振り下ろす。 ご褒美に、グロテスクな噴水を見る事ができる。

items.name: Vis Halberd
items.description: A weapon with spiral force. The three-pronged blade tears apart enemies.

items.name: Demonic Destroyer (Reverse)
items.description: 使い方は単純。 まず、頭上高くこの斧を振り上げ、 敵にめがけて真っ直ぐに振り下ろす。 ご褒美に、グロテスクな噴水を見る事ができる。 裏社会で作成されたデモナ・デストロイヤーの亜種。

items.name: トレースハルベルト
items.description: 追撃の力が込められた武器。 三又に分かれた刃が敵を切り刻む。

items.name: 永劫のマナイーター
items.description: 死招刃を分析し、人間の手による再現を試みた品。 ある軍需企業製の試作品で、市販量産品では まず考えられないほどの、高性能に仕上がっている。

items.name: ゴールデン杵α
items.description: 謹賀新年 金色に輝く、 見るだけでおめでたい気分になる杵。

items.name: Cherry Blossom Pouch (Scarlet)
items.description: A multi-purpose scarlet pouch. Fashionable and functional.

items.name: Cherry Blossom Pouch (Violet)
items.description: A multi-purpose violet pouch. Fashionable and functional.

items.name: Cherry Blossom Pouch (White/Pink)
items.description: A multi-purpose white and pink pouch. Fashionable and functional.

items.name: 桜巾着（白磁）

items.name: Nambu Type 100
items.description: A handgun based on the design of that commissioned by the Japan LAW Syndicate.

items.name: Titanomachia
items.description: A spiritual gun imbued with the magic of Hecatonchires. Further research may enhance this weapon's capability.

items.name: Type 54
items.description: A handgun with huge piercing power that was officially commissioned by the Communist Army to better deal with the Rambuses.

items.name: Desert Rambus
items.description: When it was first launched, this weapon was the most powerful handgun in the world.

items.name: Rambus 92FS
items.description: An automatic 9mm handgun used by syndicates around the world.

items.name: Raygun
items.description: A handgun made more powerful with the infusion of spiritual powers and used to deal out justice.

items.name: Walther AC41
items.description: A handgun used by the greatest thief of the last century, of whom it was said there was nothing he couldn't steal.

items.name: Sweeper
items.description: A revolver used by an assassin known as the Cleaner.

items.name: Marsbuster
items.description: A raygun created by a mad scientist who predicted the invasion of Martians.

items.name: Reaper's Colt
items.description: A handgun that chips away at the life of those who wield it in exchange for the horrifying power to be able to instantly kill anything they hit.

items.name: Nambu Type 100 (Mystical)
items.description: A handgun based on the design of that commissioned by the Japan Law Syndicate. A mysterious power contained within slightly reduces skill cool-down times.

items.name: Nambu Type 100 (Unnatural)
items.description: A handgun based on the design of that commissioned by the Japan Law Syndicate. A mysterious power contained within reduces skill cool-down times.

items.name: Five Spirit Shooter
items.description: [CHAOS Players Only] An ancient gun left over in this world that uses spiritual powers to fire sharp bullets. Only those seeking power may lay their hands on this weapon.

items.name: Lotus Purifier
items.description: [Players at Level 40 or Above Only] A holy gun designed to cleanse evil beings that is said to have the power to erase the desires of those who wield it.

items.name: Sweeper
items.description: A revolver used by an assassin known as the Cleaner.

items.name: Five Spirit Shooter (Junk)
items.description: [CHAOS Players Only] A Five Spirit Shooter that was discarded during the manufacturing process for its faulty make. Although not as powerful, it still makes a capable weapon.

items.name: Type 54 (Modified)
items.description: A modified Type 54 that reduces its knockback effect while increasing its penetrability.

items.name: Nambu Typ 100 (Argyros)
items.description: A Nambu Type 100 with minor modification. By tweaking its interior mechanism, function has slightly improved.

items.name: Cal' Maria
items.description: A latent sense of serenity overwhelms those who find themselves at the other end of this gun. In the instant their life begins to fade away, the Cal' Maria absolves them of all their sins.

items.name: Five Spirit Shooter (Rapid)
items.description: A well-made imitation of a Five Spirit Shooter. It looks exactly like a Five Spirit Shooter, but because it was made differently, its functions are completely different as well.

items.name: Nambu Type 100 (4th)
items.description: [Debug Use] A handgun based on the design of that commissioned by the Japan Law Syndicate.

items.name: Type 54 (5th)
items.description: [Debug Use] A handgun with huge piercing power that was officially commissioned by the Communist Army to better deal with the Rambuses.

items.name: M103-L
items.description: A long-barreled machine pistol developed for taking down vicious criminals. Has huge destructive powers for a handgun.

items.name: Trainee Gun
items.description: [Debug Use] A pistol for training purposes.

items.name: Dead West
items.description: [Players at Level 60 or Above Only] Lured by the promise of gold, hundreds of starving men once drifted to the West only to die in the light of the setting sun. Their unfulfilled dreams turned to grudges that forevermore haunted their guns.

items.name: Nightwalker
items.description: A handgun designed to maintain accuracy even when used in the dark of night.

items.name: Beginner's Handgun
items.description: [Players at Level 30 or Below Only] An easy-to-use handgun made for the newbie Demon Buster.

items.name: Red Rain
items.description: A small, vertical twin-barrel mounted gun that fits in the palm of an adult hand. Its portability and concealability make it an assassin's weapon of choice.

items.name: Death Walker
items.description: A customized handgun which has improved upon the killing power of the Nightwalker. Its setup is prohibitive for all but advanced users, but it's the best firearm for those extreme situations.

items.name: Mobile Inferno
items.description: The flames that shoot from the muzzle of this gun will engulf your enemies in a ceaseless blaze.

items.name: Baby Smile
items.description: A handgun that fires a rapid amount of revolutions that explode upon contact.

items.name: Full Metal Shooter
items.description: A handgun that was created to quickly develop skills against impending threats

items.name: Para Bellum
items.description: A firearm imbued with an understated power exerted only to maintain the peace.

items.name: Golden Gun
items.description: A firearm once owned by a skilled assassin who lived somewhere in the East

items.name: Handgun D
items.description: Compact and light. No flaws are seen in its design. An exemplary handgun.

items.name: Nightmare Sacrifice
items.description: Don't spit on yourself. Spit in the face of the guy who makes you sick. Flip him off and laugh. But when he comes around, remember that he's an ally.

items.name: Holy Exorcism
items.description: The deep dark that came like the draft stagnates and the tepid wind is shrouded. The trail of shining bullet came out of nowhere. It was like the sun rises in the horizon. The trail gradually strengthened its brightness and all the darkness becomes a thing of the past.

items.name: Tartarusmachy
items.description: A spiritual gun imbued with a large dose of Hecatonchires' magic.

items.name: Five Spirit Shooter (Flash)
items.description: A handgun crafted from a Five Spirit Shooter and designed to weed out the weak from this world. It fires bullets like flashes of light, so that the weak cannot even begin to follow their trajectories. Cannot be traded or repaired.

items.name: Baby Smile (Destruction)
items.description: A handgun that fires a rapid amount of revolutions that explode contact. This special modified handgun can destruct any things

items.description: A pistol of death that feeds on the life of its wielder. Those lacking a strong heart will soon lose their soul and flesh to this weapon.

items.name: Pesticide

items.name: Evil Blaster
items.description: A once-righteous gun that held a distinguished record for having shot down countless demons, it has since been twisted by the dark desires of the demons whose lives it has claimed. When fired, the shots sound of the demons' dying agony. Landing consecutive blows on an enemy results in a 20% chance of inflicting that enemy with 窶徘aralysis.窶・ Special abilities cannot be transferred via Soul Fusion, etc.

items.name: Nambu Type 108
items.description: A replica of a handgun adopted by a certain organization in Shinjuku. The creators hoped to make a weapon as strong as the original but they were displeased with the results. Unable to come up with anything better however

items.name: Stone Gazer
items.description: An old-fashioned gun discovered in the ruins. The barrel of the gun is furnished with a special mechanism but it's unclear whether it is functional or not.

items.name: Shangri-la
items.description: This handgun acquired its nickname after it was said that one shot could send you to paradise. With its attractive design and ease of use, this prototype is popular with both high-ranking officials and technical engineers. Landing consecutive blows on an enemy results in a 20% chance of inflicting that enemy with 窶彡harm.窶・ Special abilities cannot be transferred via Soul Fusion, etc.

items.name: Antikithera Sky
items.description: A unique mechanism with the alias One who knows the stars" awoke from sleep and will give the user a precise shooting ability. It will show its full potential under a full moon."

items.name: Mercedes
items.description: A merciful attack on your partner and a merciless attack on your enemy. Is the design of this magical gun. Temporarily learn the skill Break Tuner". It has these abilities but they cannot be transferred via Soul Fusion

items.name: Mercedes Devil
items.description: A merciful attack on your Demon and a merciless attack on your enemy. Is the design of this magical gun. Temporarily learn the skill Break Tuner: Devil". It has these abilities but they cannot be transferred via Soul Fusion

items.name: Pillow Shot
items.description: A custom automatic handgun used in the last great war. Even after so much time its superb workmanship means it is regularly used by gun lover's today. Temporarily learn the skill Double Tap". Temporarily learn the skill "Head Shot". It has these abilities but they cannot be transferred via Soul Fusion

items.name: ヘンゲル２８０
items.description: 競技用のハンドガン。 調整可能な重量バランスや利き手に フィットする左右非対称のグリップ等、 精密射撃に特化された設計となっている。 反動を小さくするために破壊力は抑えられており、 本来戦闘には不向きであるが、 使いこなせれば確実に標的を射抜くことができる。

items.name: ペプラーＳＤＰ
items.description: 画期的な反動吸収機構を搭載し、 ストッピングパワーと命中率の両立を目指した銃。 射線が手首と同軸にあるのも制動に一役買っている。

items.name: Lovers Shot
items.description: 意中の相手なら敵味方関係なく 撃ち抜く愛を込めた銃。 想いよ届け！

items.name: ベイビースマイルⅡ（破壊）
items.description: 異常なまでに回転数を上げた弾丸を射出することで、 対象に接触した瞬間に爆炎を巻き起こすハンドガン。 さらなる改修により、 あらゆる物を破壊し尽くす力を持っている。

items.name: ホーリーエクソシズムⅡ（破壊）
items.description: すきま風の様にやってきた闇は深く、 そして澱み、生ぬるい風が立ち込めている。 どこからともなく放たれた光り輝く銃弾の軌跡。 それはまるで水平線から昇る太陽の様。 軌跡は徐々にその明るさを強め、 全ての闇を過去のものにする。 さらなる改修により、 あらゆる物を破壊し尽くす力を持っている。

items.name: Ｎ・サクリファイスⅡ（破壊）
items.description: 自分に唾吐く真似はやめろ。 いっその事、ムカつくあいつに吐きかけろ。 中指立てて、ニヤニヤしろ。 向かってきたら、あいつも俺らの仲間さ。 さらなる改修により、 あらゆる物を破壊し尽くす力を持っている。

items.name: フリントロックピストル
items.description: かつて宝石に目が無い 強欲で貪欲な海賊が使っていた銃。 装飾部分には、自然の風景が描かれた 模様が刻まれている。

items.name: 海鳴りのフリントロックピストル

items.name: ヴィスレボルバー
items.description: 螺旋の力が込められた武器。 二つの銃口から発射される弾丸が、敵を打ち抜く。

items.name: Demonic Pointer
items.description: 使い方は単純。 まず、弾丸を込め、 敵にめがけて引き金を引く。 ご褒美に、グロテスクなサークルを見る事ができる。

items.name: チョコピストル
items.description: 持っているとすぐに手がベトベトになる。 お菓子が大好きな悪魔たちの目の前に出せば、 目を輝かせて惹きつけること間違いなし！ 隙だらけのときに撃てば、悪魔は幸せな夢を抱いて 昇天することでしょう。
