items.description: This gun was once sealed away in a distant weapons factory because of its frightening destructive force. Said to mock the reach of the gods its special modifications give it the power to effortlessly blow away most enemies.

items.name: Night Shocker
items.description: A shotgun that buries enemy along with the darkness.

items.name: Crossfire (Fierce Attack)
items.description: A holy gun decked out with various divine symbology. The words inscribed all over its exterior grant its user the power to defend against destruction and chaos. Any who hold the weapon gain an increase in ferocity.

items.name: Crossfire (Fierce Attack  Light)
items.description: A holy gun decked out with various divine symbology. The words inscribed all over its exterior grant its user the power to defend against destruction and chaos. Any who hold the weapon gain a slight increase in ferocity.

items.name: Flowering Pumpkin S
items.description: Saien cultivated these at home and the vines flowered. To remember this wonderful moment he tried making it into a shotgun. S stands for sample. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Flowering Pumpkin N
items.description: Saien cultivated these at home and the vines flowered. To remember this wonderful moment he tried making it into a shotgun. N stands for normal. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Flowering Pumpkin G
items.description: Saien cultivated these at home and the vines flowered. To remember this wonderful moment he tried making it into a shotgun. G stands for great.

items.name: Freelen Sentinel
items.description: The gun, Sentinel, imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power. Can become even stronger by mixing with Fimbulvet's Sword Crystal (Gun).

items.name: Freelen Sentinel+1
items.description: The gun, Sentinel, imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power.

items.name: Freelen Sentinel+2
items.description: The gun, Sentinel, imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power. Can become even stronger by Tarot Fusion with Norn's Crystal and Soul Stone Fusion with Nyx's Crystal.

items.name: Freelen Sentinel+3
items.description: The gun, Sentinel, imbued with Fimbulvet's cold power. It is at its maximum power.

items.name: ガビアル
items.description: 闇夜を切り裂き、敵を撃ち抜くショットガン。 その姿は、敵を慄然とさせる。

items.name: ベアトリス
items.description: 慈悲の一撃を仲間に撃ち、無慈悲な一撃を敵へ撃つ。 というコンセプトで製造された魔銃。

items.name: ベアトリス・デビル
items.description: 慈悲の一撃を仲魔に撃ち、無慈悲な一撃を敵へ撃つ。 というコンセプトで製造された魔銃。

items.name: Ｈａｉｌ－Ⅱ（破壊）
items.description: 銃全体を冷却することにより、 外部からの熱伝導を極限まで遮断し、 威力を向上させたショットガン。 その冷気は、銃創ごと凍結させ、 痛みすら知らせないまま命を奪う。 さらなる改修により、 あらゆる物を破壊し尽くす力を持っている。

items.name: Ｒｅ－１３Ⅱ（破壊）
items.description: かの銃工が、その強力な威力が故に 創ることを自ら封印した銃。 人知を凌駕したその威力は、 神の領域を嘲笑するかの如く敵を踏み躙る。 さらなる改修により、 あらゆる物を破壊し尽くす力を持っている。

items.name: ネクサス・センチネル
items.description: 神に歯向かう者を殲滅するため、 センチネルに改造を施したショットガン。 その銃口は光に包まれ、 仲魔への想いが込められている。

items.name: 雷公砲・改
items.description: 荷電された弾丸を撃ちだす銃。 撃ちだす弾は電撃を帯び、敵を激砕する。

items.name: ジャッジメントデイ・改
items.description: 祝福を施された銃身から放たれる弾丸は、 全ての罪を浄化し、魂を昇天させる。

items.name: 天威霧砲・改
items.description: テンイムホウ 天の威光すら霧散させるほどの呪いを、 幾重にもかけられた銃口は、 覗いた者を冥府へ招くという。

items.name: Ｇｒａｖｅｌ－Ｉ・改
items.description: 発射時に銃身内を急速に冷却する事で 超低温の弾丸を射出するショットガン。 凍結した弾丸により目標を激砕する。

items.name: ＳＣＡＴＴＥＲ－ＳＧ・改
items.description: セミオートマチック式のショットガンに 改良を施した一品。 非常にコンパクトに作られており、 耐久性と信頼性に優れている。

items.name: ＧＡＭＩＣ－２０・改
items.description: 物理的損傷を受け付けない敵に対抗するため 改良をおこなったレールガン。 銃身に魔術的処理を施しており、 撃ち出される弾丸は呪力を帯びて敵を激砕する。

items.name: ブルトレーゲン・改
items.description: セミオートマチック式のショットガンに 改良を施した一品。 暴徒の鎮圧などに威力を発揮する。

items.name: ブレイジングフリッカー・改
items.description: セミオートマチック式のショットガンに 改良を施した一品。 燃えるような銃身からは 炎のような弾丸が放たれる。

items.name: パニッシュメント・改
items.description: 焼け付いたような銃口から放たれる弾丸は、 情け容赦なく敵を激砕する。

items.name: ベアトリスⅡ
items.description: 慈悲の一撃を味方に撃ち、無慈悲な一撃を敵へ撃つ。 というコンセプトでカスタムされた魔銃。

items.name: ベアトリス・デビルⅡ
items.description: 慈悲の一撃を味方に撃ち、無慈悲な一撃を敵へ撃つ。 というコンセプトでカスタムされた魔銃。

items.name: ヴィススカッター
items.description: 螺旋の力が込められた武器。 三つの銃口から発射される弾丸が、敵を貫く。

items.name: ハナサクカボチャ・Ｕ
items.description: サイエンが自家栽培したカボチャから 伸びた蔓が花を咲かせたので、 素敵な一幕を記念にすべく、 とりあえずショットガンにしてみました。 ほんでもって更に改造しました。 ＵはＵＬＴＩＭＡＴＥの意。

items.name: ルドルフクラッカー
items.description: 子供用のオモチャとして作られた銃だが、 電池が切れているようだ……。

items.name: ルドルフクラッカーⅡ
items.description: 子供用のオモチャとして作られた銃。 鼻が光るギミックつき！

items.name: 聖・ルドルフクラッカー
items.description: 子供用のオモチャとして作られた銃。 奇跡が起こり、少し実用的になった……のか？

items.name: Brahma Sutra
items.description: 再創造を担う神が持つ、経典の名を冠した銃。 物理領域を破滅させる威力を誇るという。 悪魔の力をその身に宿した時、 真価を発揮する。

items.name: Demonic Splusher (Reverse)
items.description: 使い方は単純。 まず、弾丸を込め、 敵にめがけて引き金を引く。 ご褒美に、グロテスクな蜂の巣を見る事ができる。 裏社会で作成されたデモナ・スプラッシャーの亜種。

items.name: ＭＧ９６Ａ
items.description: 異世界のトウキョウにいる とある女性のデビルバスターが 扱う機関銃。

items.name: ヤクトセンチネル
items.description: 対峙する者全てを殲滅するため、 センチネルに改造を施したショットガン。 その銃口からは逃れることが出来ない。

items.name: ヴァイパーショット・Ｗ
items.description: 蛇の形をした白いショットガン。

items.name: ヴァイパーショット・Ｗ＋１
items.description: 蛇の形をした白いショットガン。

items.name: ヴァイパーショット・Ｗ＋２
items.description: 蛇の形をした白いショットガン。

items.name: ヴァイパーショット・Ｗ＋３
items.description: 蛇の形をした白いショットガン。

items.name: ヴァイパーショット・Ｒ
items.description: 蛇の形をした赤いショットガン。

items.name: ヴァイパーショット・Ｒ＋１
items.description: 蛇の形をした赤いショットガン。

items.name: ヴァイパーショット・Ｒ＋２
items.description: 蛇の形をした赤いショットガン。

items.name: ヴァイパーショット・Ｒ＋３
items.description: 蛇の形をした赤いショットガン。

items.name: Fiery Tenjin Cannon
items.description: 艱難辛苦を打ち払い、 維新への道を切り開く筒。

items.name: Demonic Scatterer
items.description: 使い方は単純。 まず、弾丸を込め、 敵の急所にめがけて引き金を引く。 ご褒美に、綺麗な音色を聴く事ができる。

items.name: フルオート・イレブン
items.description: フルオート射撃が可能なショットガン。

items.name: アーベントイヤーⅡ（破壊）
items.description: 魔界の炎を封じ込めている為、 刀身が異常に肥大化した剣。 さらなる改修により、 あらゆる物を破壊し尽くす力を持っている。

items.name: 螺旋のオルクリスト
items.description: 自分よりも大きな存在を 相手にする為に作られた両手剣。 醜き者は去れ。 螺旋の理が秘められている。

items.name: ネクサス・ストライカー
items.description: 鬼才故に蔑まれ、 疎まれた刀鍛冶が鍛えた剣を模したもの。 オリジナルには及ばないが、 あらゆる思念を吸収して肥大化してゆく。 仲魔への想いが込められている。

items.name: コテツ弐式（拝神）・異
items.description: オガミが使用していたものを模した刀。 刀身に「長曽祢興里入道虎徹」の銘が刻まれており、 オリジナルに劣らない禍々しさが漂っている。 ※装備すると、通常時の 　待機モーションと移動モーションが変化する。 ※他の、モーションが変わるアイテムを 　同時に装備している場合、組み合わせによっては 　このアイテムのモーションは適用されない。

items.name: メッサーラ
items.description: 紅に染まっている電子の剣。 あらゆる戦況を考慮して作られているので、 見かけ以上に多面的に使える。

items.name: 膝丸
items.description: 源氏の棟梁の間に受け継がれてきた刀。 罪人を切れば膝まで切れたという。

items.name: 蜘蛛切
items.description: 源氏の棟梁の間に受け継がれてきた刀。 源頼光がこの刀で土蜘蛛を切り伏せたという。

items.name: 吠丸
items.description: 源氏の棟梁の間に受け継がれてきた刀。 夜毎、蛇の鳴くような声で吠えたという。

items.name: 薄緑
items.description: 源氏の棟梁の間に受け継がれてきた刀。 Yoshitsuneが熊野権現より受け継ぎ 愛用したとされる。

items.name: 青雷刀
items.description: 青い電撃を刀身に宿した刀。 その昔、オニビトが帯刀したと 伝えられている。

items.name: 毘沙霊刃・改
items.description: 猛々しき武神の力を刃に込めた霊刀を さらに磨き上げた逸品。 眩き刃は魔性の輝きを放ち、敵を一刀の下に 斬り伏せる。

items.name: 天楼白刃・改
items.description: 天に昇る流星の軌跡のような太刀筋を 残すことから名付けられた霊剣。 その刃は磨き上げられ、 以前に比べ切れ味が増している。

items.name: 影斬・改
items.description: 光あるところに影があるように、 鬼斬、神斬の裏打ちとなった日本刀。 物体の隙間に差し込まれる影のように、 あらゆる物体を貫く切れ味を持つ。

items.name: 暴雀舞刃・改
items.description: ボウジャクブジン 羽毛のように軽いその刀身により、 刹那で敵の全身に、 無数の猛禽に襲われたような裂傷を与える。

items.name: 妖刀・零・改
items.description: 一太刀で、敵を内より凍結し、 出血させることなく絶命させる妖刀。

items.name: 燕墜刀・改
items.description: 鋭い刃が輝く長尺の刀。 とある工房で作られた特注品の刀身を磨き上げた逸品。 依頼主以外にはまともに扱えない。

items.name: フランボワヤン・改
items.description: 火柱のような波状の紅い刀身をもつ美しい大型剣。 波打つ紅き刃で斬られた傷は焼け爛れ、 致命傷を与える。

items.name: ショテルセレスチャル・改
items.description: 天の光を纏った刀剣で、握る者に星々の 加護をもたらす。

items.name: イナズマ・エッジ・改
items.description: イナズマの力を封じ込めた剣。 電光の如き太刀筋で相手を圧倒する。

items.name: アリス十番のチェーンソー
items.description: 異なるトウキョウの メタルアイドルユニットが 手に持つチェーンソー。

items.name: True アリス十番のチェーンソー
items.description: 異なるトウキョウの メタルアイドルユニットが 手に持つキュートでポップな 見た目のチェーンソー。

items.name: 宝刀・蜘蛛切
items.description: 源氏の棟梁の間に受け継がれてきた刀。 源頼光がこの刀で土蜘蛛を切り伏せたという。 秘伝の技術を用いることで、切れ味が増している。

items.name: 宝刀・吠丸
items.description: 源氏の棟梁の間に受け継がれてきた刀。 夜毎、蛇の鳴くような声で吠えたという。 秘伝の技術を用いることで、切れ味が増している。

items.name: 宝刀・薄緑

Also by showing it to Jack Frost in East Shinagawa Great Ice Hole you can transport to a place of your choice. Can be used repeatedly during the time frame. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Egg of Pangu
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this strange egg contains the very essence of the earth.

items.name: Ten Commandments Tablets
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, the tablets have been inscribed with the ten covenants formed between the One True God and the Savior.

items.name: Oracle Mirror
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this mirror was handed down to men by one who was once revered as a god, so that he may convey his wishes directly to them.

items.name: Crown of the Abyss
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this crown symbolizes the highest rank attainable in the world that lurks in the darkest depths of the earth.

items.name: Bird's Spittle
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this mystical ingredient is said to have once been used by the Dvergar in crafting the magical collar Gleipnir.

items.name: Cat's Footfall
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this mystical ingredient is said to have once been used by the Dvergar in crafting the magical collar Gleipnir.

items.name: Platinum Spirit Money
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this platinum coin was once buried along with the bodies of the dead. If silver spirit money is used to pay the demons that dwell in hell, and gold spirit money is used to pay the deities that live in the heavens, to whom would platinum spirit money be offered?

items.name: Damascus Chakram
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this disc-like throwing weapon was said to have been crafted out of a sacred metal by ancient gods. Indians attempted to replicate this metal in the medieval period, but what they created was refined in Damascus, which is where Damascus steel gets its name. It is a difficult weapon for humans to wield.

items.name: Amenonuboko
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this spear was left behind by the Kotoamatsukami, gods even more ancient than the Heavenly Gods and Nation Rulers, and is a difficult weapon to wield.

items.name: Astral Crystal
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this crystal formed from materialized astral matter contains a high concentration of spirits of great purity that control alignment.

items.name: Necronomicon
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this evil tome contains spells for controlling the dead. The twisted poet who authored this book is said to have been devoured alive by an invisible monster.

items.name: Cintamani
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this sacred jewel is said to have been located below the jaw of a dragon. Coral stars float within the jewel's orb, and those who possess it are said to be granted any wish they desire.

items.name: Rheingold
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this sacred material has the power to fulfill the desires of its owner. Although valueless as a metal due to the numerous impurities it contains, magical rings and helmets are said to have been crafted from this gold.

items.name: Leather of Amalthea
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this leather was taken off of the hide of Amalthea, the Goat Goddess. Aegis, the shield that Zeus offered to Athena as a gift, is said to have been made from this very leather.

items.name: Ark of the Law
items.description: A miracle produced by the hands of humans, this object cannot easily be recreated. It is made from a similar material to the Ark that once contained the Ten Commandments Tablets.

items.name: Mithril Wheel
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this cog was made from a legendary, highly durable and processable metal. Its maker and purpose, however, remain unknown.

items.name: Broken Noble Metal Archive
items.description: A case containing precious metals. Can be used like Remains of Tokyo to extract elements. It appears to broken, and contains very little that can be used. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Broken Quality Wood Archive
items.description: A case containing rare wood materials. Can be used like Remains of Tokyo to extract elements. It appears to broken, and contains very little that can be used. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Broken Legendary Archive
items.description: A case containing unusual materials. Can be used like Remains of Tokyo to extract elements. It appears to broken, and contains very little that can be used. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Asada Archive
items.description: An archive full of materials hand-selected by DB Asada. Can be deconstructed with an Extractor to obtain items.

items.name: Strip of Shadow
items.description: An object into which the four oni of Fujiwara-no-Chikata have been trapped.

items.name: OOPTH of Hatred
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this evil tome contains spells for controlling the dead. The twisted poet who authored this book is said to have been devoured alive by an invisible monster. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Healing
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this mystical ingredient is said to have once been used by the Dvergar in crafting the magical collar Gleipnir. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Contentment
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this leather was taken off of the hide of Amalthea, the Goat Goddess. The Aegis shield that Zeus offered to Athena as a gift, is said to have been made from this leather. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Obedience
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, the tablets have been inscribed with the ten covenants formed between the One True God and the Savior. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Wish
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this sacred jewel is said to have been located below the jaw of a dragon. Coral stars float within the jewel's orb, and those who possess it are said to be granted any wish they desire. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Desire
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this sacred material has the power to fulfill the desires of its owner. Although valueless as a metal due to the numerous impurities it contains, magical rings and helmets are said to have been crafted from this gold. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Slight Blindness
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man Platinum coin burred with the dead. It's said that Gold Spirit Money is paid to deities and Buddhas Silver Spirit Money is paid to demons of hell. Then for whom was the Platinum Spirit Money made for... Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Little Grief
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man Sign of the one who is of the high rank in the world of Abyss. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Little Wonder
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man It's not easy to create the same exact thing. It's supposedly made of the same material as what the 10 Commandment tablet was stored in. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Small Sign
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man The one whom was worshiped as a god gave this mirror to humanity so they can share thoughts. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Little Thirst
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man this mystical ingredient is said to have once been used by the Dvergar The rumor is that it was used to craft the magical collar Gleipnir. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Small Celebration
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man Mystical egg said to be filled with materials of the earth. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

items.name: Yoiyami Kitan
items.description: An object that seems to inspire feelings of wonder and majesty. For whatever reason though it reeks of alcohol... Cannot be traded.

items.name: HEPA
items.description: Amplification liquid developed in research process of cultivation. Although it has already been decomposed it can be used culture.

items.name: Culture Booster (1 day)
items.description: When it is used as manure item in culture culture machine can accumulate the permissible concentration up to the amount culture machine can accumulate for 1 day. Cannot be traded or sold.

items.name: Culture Booster (Entire period)
items.description: When it is used as manure item in culture culture machine can accumulate the permissible concentration up to its limit. Cannot be traded or sold.

items.name: Roaring Hammer of Life's Lament
items.description: An odd amalgamation that is sensitive to even the most delicate of ripples in the time stream. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Bitter Alcohol of Deceit
items.description: An unpalatable alcohol that was used to dye the earth red and seal away a certain object. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Red String of Fate
items.description: The length of this crimson thread determines the duration of your life. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Chronometer of Destiny
items.description: A timepiece that solemnly carves the predetermined timespan. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Nacre Crimson Shoes
items.description: Red heels with the faint smell of the one who liked to wear them. Cannot be traded.

items.name: Cloak of Yakumo
items.description: A cloak worn by a hero who left his mark on the land of eight clouds.

items.name: Divine Bracer
items.description: An accessory that lets off a thunderous sound when firing a bow.

items.name: 陽光の髪飾り
items.description: 全てを照らしだす燦々とした陽光が 封じられた物体。

items.name: Element: Dark Liquid

items.name: Element: Strengthening Agent
items.description: A Strengthening Agent Element acquired by deconstructing Remains of Tokyo. This Element can be used in Compounding, and is traded for a fairly high price. Automatically removed from inventory and placed into Fuel Tank when used.

items.name: Element: Soft Stone
items.description: An Element known as Soft Stone, acquired by deconstructing Remains of Tokyo. Although it can be used in Compounding, its existence itself remains unproven. Automatically removed from inventory and placed into Fuel Tank when used.

items.name: Balm of Life (Dungeon)
items.description: Allows your demon to resurrect on the spot when your demon die without losing any XP. Can only be used in the deepest parts of a dungeon.

items.name: Revival Beads (Dungeon)
items.description: Resurrects all dead party members and their Demon Friends in the same zone as yourself with 100% of their MAX HP restored and without any XP loss. Can only be used in the deepest parts of a dungeon. Effect applies only to party members in the same map as the user.

items.name: Blastone (Demon Dungeon)
items.description: A Debug Item for Demon Friend dungeons. Knocks back an enemy and inflicts Stone.

items.name: Stone Napalm (Demon Dungeon)
items.description: A Debug Item for Demon Friend dungeons. Knocks back nearby enemies and inflicts Stone.

items.name: Ariadne's Thread (Demon Dungeon)
items.description: A Debug Item for Demon Friend dungeons. A piece of thread sent down by the gods that can take you immediately to the location of your choice.

items.name: Orb of Speed (Demon Dungeon)
items.description: A Debug Item for Demon Friend dungeons. Increases your movement and that of your Demon Friends by 50% for 60 minutes. However, movement is reduced to the normal speed during battle and skill execution. Effect is overridden when the same item, another Orb of Speed or a Beads of Speed is used.

items.name: High-Grade Emergency Cure (Dungeon)
items.description: Immediately restores 100HP to your summoned Demon Friend. Can be used even while performing a skill or suffering damage. Can be used consecutively. Can only be used in the deepest parts of a dungeon. Automatically applied to your summoned Demon Friends when used.

items.name: 兵信魔符・？？遁？（魔具）
items.description: 必勝の法が封じられた呪符。 使用することで解放できる力は大きく限られる。 （！）のつくダンジョンを 仲魔のみで進入した際に使用できる。 使用する事で、召喚中の仲魔に対して 以下の状態変化を付与する。 ・近接、射撃、魔法、補助＋１ この効果は、 最大で３０回まで重ねて適用される。 効果は、２０秒間持続する。 ※使用期限内は何度でも使用可能。
